# System setup

-   <https://www.python.org/ftp/python/>

```
python-1.2.3-amd64.exe
```

Check box for `Add python.exe to PATH`

`C:\Users\username\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python123\Lib\site-packages`

## Version labels

| Version     | Interpreted as         |
|-------------|------------------------|
| 0.1.0a1     | Alpha 1                |
| 0.1.0b1     | Beta 1                 |
| 0.1.0rc1    | Release Candidate 1    |
| 0.1.0       | Final release          |

## Quarto

```
pip install pyyaml jupyter
```

# PyPI

-   <https://pypi.org/search/>
-   <https://pypi.org/classifiers/>
-   <https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/tutorials/packaging-projects/>
-   <https://pypi.org/help/#apitoken>

Build the package:

```
cd path/to/mypackage/
python -m pip install --upgrade build
python -m build
```

Upload to TestPyPI (use recovery code then regenerate): <https://test.pypi.org/project/mypackage/1.2.3/>

```
python -m pip install --upgrade twine
python -m twine upload --repository testpypi dist/*
```

Then install from TestPyPI:

```
python -m pip install -i https://test.pypi.org/simple/ mypackage
```

Upload to PyPI (use recovery code then regenerate): <https://pypi.org/project/mypackage/1.2.3/>

```
python -m twine upload dist/*
```
